title: 第3774章 声东击西故入樊笼第3773章 出手诱饵暗布森罗
content_zh:
阴风呼啸，李观棋掌心扣住一头孤魂野鬼的脑袋，猛地将其魂体震碎！
恐怖的吞噬之力从他掌心传出，竟是将那孤魂野鬼的魂力尽数吸收。
李观棋已经不知道自己杀了多少孤魂野鬼了。
此时他已经快要接近森罗城了。
他所在的位置距离森罗城足有三千里。
可不知道为什么，他总觉得这一路心神不宁，仿佛有什么不好的事儿要发生。
略微苏醒的孟婉舒传音给他。
“夫君，要不要休息一下。”
李观棋摇了摇头，碾碎冥晶吸收其中冥蕴，低声道。
“不行，我感觉有点不对劲儿。”
“傅临渊手里一定有附近的地图，如果他足够聪明，一定会猜到我不会回森罗城。”
“甚至他能猜出来我会绕路去万饶城。”
李观棋如今身处一片群山峻岭之中，冥蕴浓郁，但孤魂野鬼也不少。
不少游魂都把这些地方当做自己的栖身之所。
李观棋在思考的时候甚至都不敢停下来。
与此同时，当他猜测傅临渊可能会猜到自己的意图之后，他就已经开始绕路。
突然！！！
李观棋身形一闪，身形隐匿于山林之间，猛然转头看向远方。
“快点！”
“大人下令，严查最近出现的游魂。”

咻咻咻！！！
破空声接二连三的响起，李观棋眼眸虚眯。
“果然……动作好快！！”
李观棋不敢有丝毫的耽搁，趁着头顶鬼卒离去的空档连忙绕路而行。
幸亏他的速度要略微快上一些，没有被对方的巡逻网拦在外围……
可现在摆在他面前的选择就只有两个了。
要么按照原计划去往万饶城，但很显然傅临渊已经有所防范了。
要么……铤而走险，直接去傅临渊所掌控的新邬城！！
几乎这个念头在脑海中闪过的一刹那，李观棋就决定转道去新邬城！
现在，对于李观棋等人而言，最重要的便是去寻找足够的鬼丹和冥魂草，凝聚成冥修之躯。
如此一来，他们将不再是游魂身份，也不会被生死簿记录在册。
content_en:
The dark wind howled, Li Guanqi held the head of a lonely wild ghost with his palm, and violently shattered its soul!
The terrifying devouring power came from his palm, absorbing all the soul power of the lonely ghost.
Li Guanqi no longer knows how many ghosts he has killed.
At this time, he was almost approaching Senluo City.
His location is three thousand miles away from Senluo City.
But he didn't know why, but he always felt uneasy along the way, as if something bad was about to happen.
Meng Wanshu, who was slightly awake, sent a message to him.
"Husband, do you want to take a rest?"
Li Guanqi shook his head, crushed the Ming Crystal to absorb the Ming Yun, and whispered.
"No, I feel something is wrong."
"Fu Linyuan must have a nearby map in his hand. If he is smart enough, he will guess that I will not return to Senluo City."
"He can even guess that I will take a detour to Wanrao City."
Li Guanqi is now in the midst of mountains and ridges, full of hidden meanings, but also many lonely souls and wild ghosts.
Many wandering souls regard these places as their shelter.
Li Guanqi didn't even dare to stop when he was thinking.
At the same time, when he guessed that Fu Linyuan might guess his intentions, he had already started to take a detour.
Sudden! ! !
Li Guanqi's figure flashed, hiding among the mountains and forests, and suddenly turned his head to look into the distance.
"Hurry up!"
"Your Excellency has ordered that the wandering spirits that have appeared recently be strictly investigated."
Whoosh! ! !
The sound of breaking through the air sounded one after another, and Li Guanqi narrowed his eyes.
"Sure enough...it moves so fast!!"
Li Guanqi did not dare to delay at all, and quickly took a detour while the ghost soldiers above him left.
Fortunately, his speed was slightly faster and he was not blocked by the opponent's patrol net...
But now there are only two choices before him.
Either go to Wanrao City according to the original plan, but it is obvious that Fu Linyuan has taken precautions.
Or... take the risk and go directly to the new Wucheng controlled by Fu Linyuan! !
Almost as soon as this thought flashed through his mind, Li Guanqi decided to divert to Xinwucheng!
Now, for Li Guanqi and others, the most important thing is to find enough ghost pills and ghost grass to condense into a body of ghost cultivation.
In this way, they will no longer be wandering souls, nor will they be recorded in the Book of Life and Death.
